extraction: Anthropic managed agents visibility: structured logging enables debugging, auditing, improvement. Log schema: timestamp, agent_id, action, input_hash, output_hash, duration_ms, success, metadata. Maps to our unified-memory: each handoff writes log entry with decision_id (input_hash), agent, timestamp, CER (metadata). Orchestrator queries: 'Show all Engine→Verdict handoffs for surya' → gets decision trail. Enables post-campaign analysis.
